site: Colombia Move MCP: initialize and tools/list without a token (schemas)

error.message: Use Authenticate / Sign in in your MCP client, then tap Permitir. If no Authenticate card appears, create a personal token at https://colombiamove.com/ai/mcp/connect and give it to the assistant via a secure MCP Authorization header — never in chat. If Authenticate expired or the connector is stuck in needsAuth, remove the dead connector and re-add https://colombiamove.com/mcp with a Bearer cm_mcp_ token via host secure input, AddMcpServer headers, or mcp-remote --header-file. A stored key is not attached to an existing OAuth connector. Then call get_setup_info until authenticated is true.
